## Summary

- what problem does this change solve?
- what changed?

## Validation

- how was this tested or verified?

## Risk

- does this affect auth, secrets, infra, deployment, or licensing?

## Provenance

- is any code copied or adapted from upstream work?
- if yes, what source and license?

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated docs where needed
- [ ] I included testing or verification notes
- [ ] I preserved required notices for upstream-derived work
- [ ] My commits include `Signed-off-by:`
